question.text: Hurdle rate 10%. Year return 8%. Performance fee chargeable is:

answer.text: Nil because return is below hurdle

explanation.text: The Logic: Below hurdle => no performance fee. The Trap: Charging below hurdle contradicts the incentive design. Cross-Exam Context: Same as XIX-A, XIX-B. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Show hurdle calculations in fee invoices; clarity builds trust.
